purpose: Non-secret role model routing template for controlled runs

secret_policy.required_action: Rotate any API key that was exposed in chat before using production credentials.

runtime_requirements: Inject secrets only into a private, per-run child environment.
Do not put secrets in argv, files, stdout, stderr, Session data, evidence, snapshots, or commits.
Use isolated config, home, cache, session, log, work, and artifact directories.
Record only environment variable names, source category, presence, and non-reversible fingerprints.
Product OpenCode runs must remain separate from OpenCode hard-review runs.
